scope.model_geometry: 24 query heads / 2 KV heads / H256 / 2051 selected tokens

candidate.mechanism: 64-thread weighted-V kernel with four independent output-column recurrences per thread
candidate.retained_incumbent: strict_ordered_three_pass_spans with one output column per thread

overlap_exclusions: graphs, copies, PLE, and non-QSA kernels

leaf_screen.protocol: same actual-shape harness and immutable random K/V payload; separate cached builds
leaf_screen.limitation: The incumbent and candidate were cached-build runs in separate processes, so the magnitude is diagnostic. The candidate clearly fails the cheap leaf admission screen and was not advanced to whole-model timing.

decision.reason: Grouping four output recurrences per thread reduces active waves and increases register work; it does not beat the retained one-column-per-thread owner.
decision.next: Require a new exact QSA data-reuse mechanism or a fresh profile before another value-pass schedule. Re-rank against operation-complete prefill MoE.
